title: BhashaSutra: A Task-Centric Unified Survey of Indian NLP Datasets, Corpora, and Resources
reasoning: The paper includes dedicated sections and summary tables for bias, fairness, and cultural reasoning resources. Specifically, it reviews benchmarks that evaluate religion (e.g., Khandelwal et al. 2024 for religious stereotypes; Dipto Das et al. 2023 for religious identity) and moral reasoning (e.g., Davani et al. 2024, which includes parallel moral-value annotations).
